name: X Algo
tagline: Tells you whether to post now, quote something, or sit tight
description: This one reads two things side by side: the openly published ranking source behind the For You timeline, and how your own recent posts are actually performing at this moment. Out of that it makes a call on the next move - start something fresh, quote another account, or wait for a better window.
author: UziObi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
